entities.name: Mojca Drčar Murko
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mojca Drčar Murko is a Slovenian politician and a former Member of the European Parliament. She is a member of Liberal Democracy of Slovenia, which is part of the Alliance of Liberals and Democrats for Europe, and sits on the European Parliament's Committee on the Environment, Public Health and Food Safety.
